scope: Official Discord community invites only; repository identity, maturity, features and licensing were not audited.

coverage.selection: First-party documentation, UI/website files and community/about/support/link-related source files up to 256 KiB; bundled dependencies and generated output excluded where identifiable. Non-GitHub repositories use public repository APIs and documented mirrors.

nonGithubReview.fuzix: Codeberg paginated repository tree and first-party documentation reviewed at a pinned revision.
nonGithubReview.mineclonia: Codeberg paginated repository tree and first-party documentation reviewed at a pinned revision.
nonGithubReview.armada: Primary GitWorkshop source page is an application shell; the catalog-declared GitHub mirror was searched.
